title: Aoyagi Toya — Outdoor Cooking!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: The next morning
Campground

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (It's a bit chilly, but what a beautiful morning.)
<Morning, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That voice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, Luka, KAITO.
Good morning.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Morning. Did you sleep well?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, very.
It was morning before I knew it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I must've fallen asleep immediately after going in my tent. I was so startled by how I wasn't home when I woke up just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I suppose that's all a part of experiencing what you don't on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Exactly. That's why you should do as much as you can before it's time to go home.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, Toya, you're up already...?
KAITO and Luka are here too?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Morning, Akito. Are you about to start making breakfast?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll need to do that soon, but I was hoping to wash up first. There's supposed to be a small spring somewhere around here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A spring...? I'll go with you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, if it's safe to drink, it might be good to fetch some for everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You can drink spring water?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes! I mean, we've been blessed with such a beautiful morning. How does some coffee made with some pure spring water sound?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that does sound nice. Let's do that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry for the hold-up, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for getting started with breakfast. Is there anything you'd like us to do?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, Toya's chopping up some vegetables. Mind helping him out?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'll help you, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Let's see... Bread, ham, cucumbers, lettuce and a can of tuna... I smell some nice breakfast sandwiches coming along!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's right. Something easy that doesn't require us to build a fire.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, where'd the margarine go...?
We should spread some on the bread.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We should? But we're not toasting them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, the veggies are gonna make the bread all soggy without it. The oil in the margarine will help prevent that from happening.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Would you like me to help with that once I've finished chopping the vegetables? I've never done that before, so I'd like to give it a try...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha. Another first?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've learned so much during this trip.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You put so much on yours, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I might've gone a little overboard. My ham looks like it's about to fall out.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yours looks very neatly made, Azusawa. The way you've presented it even shows off how colorful it is.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
Yours looks so pro, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-It does?
I was hoping to brighten it up a little more, but couldn't really find anything that does that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Something brighter...? Oh, I still have some of the oranges that I brought from home. Wanna try using those?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why not try making a fruit sandwich while you're at it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How? We don't have any whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Grr...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was nice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, before I forget. You guys wanted to brew some coffee using spring water, right? Here, use this!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wait, a camp stove...?
You actually brought one?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I brought it just in case we have trouble building a campfire!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it never really got a chance to do its this thing, so I thought now's its chance...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure, let's give it a shot.
It'll save us the trouble of having to deal with a fire.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yay! I brought a dripper too, so just gimme one sec to dig it up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hum hum♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, that coffee's starting to smell really nice...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it is. Despite having coffee almost every day, it smells much better than usual for some reason...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Aww, I wish I could be there with you all...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I know! I'll go ask MEIKO to brew up some coffee! Be right back...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, have her make some for me too.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <What? Can't you just ask her yourself, Luka?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, that should be enough for all of us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that's good, if I do say so myself!
Have at it, guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thanks, An!
Oh, it smells so good...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it really does...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<Here you are, Luka.
One for you and one for me.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Thank you, KAITO!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Mmm... That hits the spot. Coffee goes so well with the wafting breeze, the chirping birds and all this greenery.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <The birds I understand, but we can't actually feel the wind from where we are...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Can't you see that I was just trying to set the mood, Luka?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haha. Okay, sorry.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Set the mood...?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This trip turned out to be such a valuable experience for me...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'll be sure to thank Mom and Dad for letting me go once I get back.)
